title: MV I need help with operating a plugin and make the pictures interactive with it.

posts.author: PoopsyTheDuck
posts.body:
I'm using Triacontane's PictureCallCommon plugin and I have no clue how to use it in the slightest to make the picture titlescreen interactive like a proper titlescreen.
For example, the "new game" button is meant to reset the cache or something and make the game back in its original position.
But when the mouse just hovers over the picture, the picture stops and enlarges itself a bit. It also applies to the other 3 options
As for the load game picture button, it's meant to load the game in the exact position of the last save file.
As for bonuses and prizes, these two are meant to be updated as the player finds prizes and bonuses but not effected by the restart of the game....
How do I do that? I legit don't know, I admit I'm afraid to ask....

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
I highly doubt anyone here is going to write a "PoopsyDuck special" tutorial just so you can skip reading and understanding the plugin file (Or even what the plugin does in the first place. Or perhaps even how RPG maker works in general, judging by what this plugin does).
If you have a specific part you don't understand how to get working, come here, explain your problem, explain what you have tried, explain what's supposed to happen, and explain what happens instead.
Then, and only then will people be incentivized to help you. Right now you just sound like a guy asking for handouts, and we don't got any of those.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
You're gonna have to let go of that. And given the fact your current abilities, I would actually put aside your entire notion of making a good game.
We have always recommended to never make your dream game first because you are going to be - by nature - far too inexperienced to make it match your vision and in the end tread water for years or even decades.
Instead, I highly recommend using RPG Maker as it is intended and learning the functions.
Take things slow, you are not going to learn over night (I think I have told you this before). Slow down, read things carefully, if you need to read things twice, and try to sort through your problems or investigate them yourself.
Once you know how to problem solve and still seem stuck, come here, give us actual details on what is going wrong and what you have tried and we'll be more than happy to assist.
However you have spammed the forums like neurotic mess which is of no benefit to you or anyone else.
Game development is about problem solving skills. Start trying to develop those.
I'm afraid to ask because of instances like this alone, I'm already afraid to seem stupid.
And yet I'm always stupid.
Click to expand...
You're only as stupid as you frame yourself. Stupidity is the lack of knowledge. Anyone can be "stupid" at anything, but anyone can become "smart" at anything.
We are not your therapist, so please don't come here to trauma dump. We're here to help you with RM, not whatever demons haunt your past.
